Jaynarayan Yadav And Another vs National Highway Authority
Of India And ... on 6 January, 2025

Author: Manoj Kumar Gupta
Bench: Manoj Kumar Gupta
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:2058-Db
Court No. - 21
Case :- Writ - C No. - 38143 of 2024
Petitioner :- Jaynarayan Yadav And Another
Respondent :- National Highway Authority Of India And 2 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Achint Ranjan Singh,Ramesh Singh

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Devendra Kumar,Swetashwa Agarwal
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
1.

The instant petition has been filed praying for a writ of mandamus directing respondent No. 2 to release compensation amount in favour of the petitioners for having acquired their land comprising of Gata No. 162m area 0.1230 hectare for widening of NH-91.
2.

According to the petitioners, their aforesaid land was notified for acquisition under the provisions of National Highways Act, 1956 and an award was declared on 16.08.2023 but compensation amount is not being released in their favour.

sentences.text: 1 3. The alleged notification under the National Highways Act has been filed at page-23 of the petition.
We have gone through it and we find that it is only a schedule to certain notification but copy of which has not been annexed.
The so-called award dated 16.08.2023 does not appear to be an award but disposal of complaint made by one Dinesh Kumar Mishra.
4. Shri Devendra Kumar, Advocate who has appeared on behalf of NHAI has placed on record an award dated 10.07.2023 but it does not relate to the subject land of the petitioners.
The facts are thus not clear, therefore, we are not in a position to examine the issues raised in the instant petition.

5. We dispose of the instant petition with direction to respondent No. 2 to examine the claim of the petitioners as contained in their representation dated 20 September 2024 and pass a speaking order within eight weeks from the date of communication of the instant order along with photocopy of the said representation.

Order Date :- 6.1.2025 Mukesh Kr.
(Anish Kumar Gupta,J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.)
